tools.name: set_stance
tools.description: Change one entity's movement stance. Reach for this when a test needs a unit crouched or sprinting without driving it through the input system.

args.name: target
args.description: The entity to change, as its NetId packed word.

args.name: sticky
args.description: Whether to keep the stance across a rewind.

target.description: The entity to change, as its NetId packed word.

sticky.description: Whether to keep the stance across a rewind. (default true)

tools.name: spawn_blueprint
tools.description: Create entities from a blueprint at the world origin. Use it to set up a scenario before stepping the simulation; it is the only way to add entities without loading a scene.

args.name: blueprint
args.description: Blueprint id, as declared in the asset graph, e.g. 'creep_melee'.

args.name: scale
args.description: Uniform scale applied to each spawned entity; omit to leave it alone.

blueprint.description: Blueprint id, as declared in the asset graph, e.g. 'creep_melee'.

scale.description: Uniform scale applied to each spawned entity; omit to leave it alone. (optional; omit for none)

tools.name: tag_entity
tools.description: Attach labels to an entity so later queries can select it by name. Useful for marking the entity a scenario is about before stepping many ticks.

args.name: target
args.description: The entity to label, as its NetId packed word.

args.name: labels
args.description: Labels to attach; each must be lower_snake_case.

target.description: The entity to label, as its NetId packed word.

labels.description: Labels to attach; each must be lower_snake_case. Several values, comma separated.
